cases.diagnosis: Opening and closing balances were extracted correctly. Source scale remains null in both bindings. OPE calls their difference dollars and divides by 1e6 without source evidence of base-dollar scale. Selected document lacks an explicit reporting multiplier, while question says in millions and reference preserves raw difference. This is not a principal/rate inversion.
cases.recommendation: Keep unknown source scale distinct from explicit ones. A magnitude conversion needs source-backed source and target scales. If an essential conversion is not grounded, propagate unknown unit information or identify insufficient scale evidence; do not invent a multiplier.
cases.do_not: Do not multiply the prediction to the reference or change official target scale solely for score improvement. External filing scale has not been verified from the provided context.
